source: owner supplied short story; manuscript retained privately
intent: A small reward exchange starts to read as reversed control, preparing the story's dark satirical premise.

shots.camera: Low three-quarter view; dog moves left-to-right toward a seated human, staying on the same side of the action axis.
shots.action: Dog walks two real steps, stops, nudges an anonymous sealed packet toward the human. The complete human arm/body remain connected; the person begins placing a small food bowl beside the dog's front paws.
shots.sound: Two paw contacts, soft packet scrape, one bowl contact; no narration needed yet.
shots.preserve: One hero model, scale, floor height, packet position, bowl and human identity. No packet contents or procedural drug-use details.

shots.camera: Closer reverse three-quarter, same action axis; match the exact placement motion across the cut.
shots.action: The bowl finishes contacting the floor. The dog looks from it to the waiting human, then calmly starts eating. The human keeps watching the dog, waiting for the next move.
shots.sound: Bowl contact continues exactly once across the cut, quiet room tone and restrained low pulse.
shots.preserve: No repeated bowl placement, teleportation, foot slip, floating hand or unexplained object motion. The implied power reversal is a proposed adaptation, not a quotation from the books.

technical_checks: Same versioned hero/set/prop references across both cameras
Root actually travels and stops; planted paws do not slide or sink
Muzzle-to-packet and bowl-to-floor contacts readable from both cameras
Cut preserves absolute action time, positions and direction
Same-frame seeks and a light-only revision preserve pose/camera timing
visual_status: 27 owner-supplied trilogy references indexed; cover-dog and industrial-set draft passports retained privately. Exact identity/scale/rig/staging and final look approval remain unresolved.
route: Free/macOS-first: test retained Three.js animal approach against the two-shot requirement before introducing another engine or rigging service.
full_story_note: The original story's escalation and bleak ending remain the adaptation baseline. A ten-second pilot does not replace or soften the whole story.
